It encapsulates input from digital health designers, clinical informatics professionals, health financing authorities, supply chain specialists, national implementers and development collaborators from low, middle and high-income nations across various regions - guaranteeing that the framework it delineates is rooted in practical implementation rather than theoretical concepts.
